changes: Explicit boneless lamb version at the original edible gram dose, with meat named in the title and weighed after trimming. It is not a goat identity alias or a bone/cooking-yield conversion. Preserve the distinct patatato potato-in-tomato method or tsigariasto low-liquid method. Separate periodic checks and serving from passive time; retain all meat fat/gravy. Any wine becomes explicitly named reviewed cooking wine; no claim of complete alcohol evaporation.
recipes.content_review: Tomat-kanelbräserat lamm där potatisen tillsätts senare och binder själva spadet. Skild från tätt paketbakat kleftiko, lökdominerad stifado med separat korn och italiensk ragu med separat polenta. Lammversionen stöds av grekiska turistmyndighetens beskrivning: https://www.visitgreece.gr/el/experiences/architecture/local-architecture/amorgos-gastronomy . Det ursprungliga getutkastet bevaras.
